prompts.original: Dramatic visualization of continuous capital outflow from South Korea to the United States. Korean Won currency symbols are depicted actively draining away from a representation of the Korean economy, flowing towards robust US Dollar symbols and a strong US economy. The overall composition conveys a sense of economic tension and the direct consequence of capital flight, with a slightly somber yet analytical mood.
